response.overview: Updated November 22, 2026  Paying Aflac starts at 1-888-788-9033 for Aflac add card: a bank source posts with no fee, a card adds a small charge.  Aflac add card: have the policy number ready, then call 1-888-788-9033 or use aflac.com, and keep what posts. Aflac pay bill no fee: have the policy number ready, then call 1-888-788-9033 or use aflac.com, and keep what posts. To sort Aflac pay bill with card, 1-888-788-9033 confirms the amount and the source, then returns a receipt as the record. The safe habit is a bank source by the due date, the receipt saved, and 1-888-788-9033 for anything unclear.
response.title: Aflac Add Card Up Front
